mapper.select: SELECT upld_id AS "uploadId",form_type_cd AS "formType",scrn_id AS "screenId",file_nm AS filename,file_size AS size, reg_user_id AS actor,upld_stat_cd AS status,tot_row_cnt AS "totalRows",succ_cnt AS "successRows",warn_cnt AS "warningRows",err_cnt AS "errorRows", trgt_proj_id AS "projectId",trgt_dstrb_step_cd AS step,aply_dttm AS "appliedAt" FROM tb_sy_upld WHERE upld_id=#{uploadId} AND form_type_cd IN ('B9','B6')

SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE col_nm='[파일]')::integer AS "fileWarningCount", count(*) FILTER (WHERE col_nm='[표]')::integer AS "tableWarningCount" FROM tb_sy_upld_err WHERE upld_id=#{uploadId} AND rslt_type_cd='WARN'
SELECT aft_val FROM tb_sy_chg_hist WHERE trgt_tbl_nm='TB_SY_UPLD' AND trgt_key=CAST(#{uploadId} AS text) AND chg_type_cd='NEW' AND chg_item_nm='검증 문맥' AND chg_rsn=#{formType} ORDER BY hist_id LIMIT 1
